name: shared-memory-manager
description: Unified memory system for all AI agents. Share, read, write, and sync memories across machines — compatible with QClaw, OpenClaw, EasyClaw, Qoder, and any agent platform.

interface.shortDescription: Share and manage memories across all AI agents
interface.longDescription: A unified memory management system that allows all intelligent agents to share, read, write, and sync memories. Supports user-level and project-level memories with standardized formats and workflows.
